items.title: shadcn-ui/chatbot-template
items.why: This is a perfect beginner-friendly starter template if you want to build and host your own AI chat web app.
items.summary: A lightweight web template for building custom AI chatbots using Next.js, Vercel AI SDK, and pre-styled UI components.

items.title: Launch HN: Speko (YC S26) – OpenRouter for Voice AI
items.why: It simplifies building voice AI applications by giving you a single API route to optimal voice models.
items.summary: Speko is a unified platform that automatically selects the best combination of speech recognition, LLM, and text-to-speech models for your application.

items.title: yetone/cumora
items.why: It shows a practical implementation of how AI agents can collaborate with developers in a shared team chat interface.
items.summary: Cumora is a cross-platform team chat app where AI agents participate as full teammates alongside human members.

items.title: dmmulroy/anti-slop
items.why: Using code checkers like this can help you learn better programming habits and write cleaner TypeScript early in your journey.
items.summary: An open-source set of code-checking rules designed to catch sloppy or low-quality JavaScript and TypeScript code patterns.

items.title: sohaibdevv/youtube-music
items.why: It is a great practical open-source project to study if you want to learn how desktop apps interact with web APIs.
items.summary: An open-source desktop client for YouTube Music that offers background playback and custom playlists without subscription ads.

items.title: Leutenegger/book-to-skill
items.why: It offers an innovative way to study CS textbooks while coding by feeding book knowledge directly into your AI assistant.
items.summary: A utility that converts technical textbook PDFs into interactive skill modules for AI coding assistants.

items.title: AI-Generated GitHub Copilot “Autofix” Allowed Compromise of Snowflake's Jira
items.why: It highlights an important real-world lesson about why developers must carefully review AI-generated code fixes.
items.summary: A security analysis detailed how an automated code fix suggested by AI allowed an unauthorized security breach.

items.title: Anthropic's War on open source AI
items.why: It gives you insight into current industry debates surrounding open-source software versus proprietary AI models.
items.summary: A community discussion examining how corporate AI strategies from major labs like Anthropic impact open-source AI developers.

items.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
items.why: It covers major foreign policy and international diplomatic developments in the Middle East.
items.summary: The US president issued military threats against Oman regarding its independent diplomatic negotiations with Iran.

items.title: Civilians paying price as Israeli military raises stakes in Lebanon: UNIFIL
items.why: It provides crucial updates on major ongoing international armed conflicts reported by UN observers.
items.summary: UN peacekeepers reported widespread daily shelling in Lebanon as local military escalations continue to affect civilians.

items.title: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake
items.why: It keeps you informed on a significant world disaster and ongoing humanitarian recovery effort.
items.summary: A major earthquake in Indonesia killed dozens and left thousands displaced while facing acute food and aid shortages.
